modelConfiguration: Unmodified Pi/runtime defaults; effective configuration captured and checked across arms
selectionReason: Frozen before any new model outputs: two cross-file contracts, two multihop chains, one alias, three caller-contract hard negatives. Selected by category, not by new arm performance. Prior r1 results were already known; r2 has not had a live evaluation.
stageDGate: All 24 challenge attempts preserved and configuration/source freeze verified; at least one strict G1 graph-assisted finding OR G1 novel-entity-to-source conversions > G0 and >= 1. Otherwise fidelity audit and stop; no prompt/corpus tuning or replacement runs.
interpretation: Mechanism replication on synthetic controlled Python PR review cases, not reproduction of LocAgent paper results. This challenge subset cannot estimate general PR quality. Stage D needs the recorded gate and independent output directory.
